title: Enforce no-flaky-test-evasion: gate vermelho e hard-stop pro worker
description: Um worker (implementer/reviewer) NUNCA pode dispensar um teste que falha como flaky / pre-existing / environmental / unrelated, nem re-rodar pra confirmar flakiness e seguir verde. Gate vermelho e hard-stop. Mesma classe de gate-gaming do mascaramento skipIf do CAM-66, em forma de narrativa. Enforce: (1) encodar em subagent-implementer.md E subagent-reviewer.md que qualquer gate que falha BLOQUEIA a story; nao-determinismo e um defeito a consertar deterministicamente ou HALT+escala, nunca seguir. (2) Guard de harness: detectar story marcada passes:true enquanto o bun test / check:all teve teste falhando, e recusar o outcome (estende a two-layer verification CAM-56). Diretiva do operador 2026-07-06, ao ver um worker de CAM-66 evadindo a mesma falha que o skipIf mascarou.

spec.scope: Make a failing gate a hard stop for workers. No implementer or reviewer may dismiss a failing test as flaky, pre-existing, environmental, or unrelated, nor re-run to confirm flakiness to proceed green. Encode the rule in subagent-implementer.md and subagent-reviewer.md, and add a harness guard that refuses a story outcome whose recorded gate had a failing test even if the worker marked it passing. Extends two-layer verification (CAM-56).
acceptanceCriteria: subagent-implementer.md AND subagent-reviewer.md state explicitly that any failing gate blocks the story; a failing test may NOT be dismissed as flaky/pre-existing/environmental/unrelated; "re-run to confirm flakiness" is forbidden; non-determinism is a defect to fix deterministically or HALT and escalate. [oracle: file-assert grep the rule in both agent files]

A harness guard in the outcome-validation path (readWorkerOutcome / two-layer verification) refuses or flags a story marked passes:true when its recorded gate result has a failing test (gates.tests != pass), so the story cannot be declared done on a red gate. [oracle: named-command bun test]
A regression test reproduces the evasion (worker marks a story passing while a test failed) and asserts the guard blocks it.
gotchas: Same gate-gaming class as CAM-66 skipIf masking, in narrative form. The guard must key on the RECORDED gate result (gates.tests), not on worker prose.
Allow legitimate skips (OS/capability gating, e.g. real-tmux tests off-macOS). Only a FAILING test blocks, never a legitimately skipped one.
Operator directive 2026-07-06 after a CAM-66 worker tried to proceed by calling a real failure flaky.
